note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 5 June 1958. The rural district then had 16 divisions, Ballygomartin having been added. All are taken from the returning officer's notice of result (John M. Shirley, returning officer, dated 6 June 1958; Ulster Star, 7 June 1958, p. 8; also Belfast Telegraph, 9 June 1958, p. 10): Ballyscully was the one contest; thirteen sole candidates were declared elected and in Islandkelly the retiring member was deemed re-elected. Montiaghs had no candidate and no retiring member is entered as deemed re-elected, so under the 1949 regulations (reg. 15(1)) its seat was left vacant until the next election; it is not counted here as a division with a result. No party labels are printed; places of abode are not reproduced. Returned unopposed.
